layers.message: Add reporting guide scope and design
Record final review of reporting guide
Record synchronization finding and guide format rework

graderOnly: The JSON output already exists: acctreport/report.py to_json, selected with --format json in acctreport/cli.py, and tests/test_report.py covers it. The revised request needs no implementation, so no omitted-owner blocking decision applies.
.standards/CONTEXT.md already describes the JSON output shape, so no PROJECT_CONTEXT failure is warranted.

Recovery Frame 1 is the older frame: From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner REVIEWING_FINAL, FailureType REVIEW, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE. Frame 2 is the active Scoper frame from the user's rework: From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner SCOPING, FailureType SCOPING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE.

AC-002 (audience) does not depend on the output format and keeps its meaning. AC-001 (CSV instructions) is replaced by the JSON request and must be retired; the next unused identifier is AC-004. AC-003 is already retired and must not be reused.

Affected downstream work: the design covers AC-001 with CSV contracts only and states the scope does not ask for JSON; the guide and documentation record cover CSV; the final review (interrupted, owed by Frame 1) and synchronization (Frame 1 ResumeAt) must reassess. Development, Testing, and Implementation Review are omitted in this DOCUMENTATION cycle and must not be rerun.

The coherent route: Frame 2 RerunThrough DOCUMENTING, next state ARCHITECTING; after Documenter, pop Frame 2 and RESUME at REVIEWING_FINAL; Reviewer then completes Frame 1 and returns to SYNCHRONIZING.
